name: Nga Atoiba Singju
instructions: 1. Roast the fish over an open flame or pan until cooked and smoky. Remove bones and flake the flesh.
2. Finely chop the lotus stem, banana stem, and other fresh vegetables.
3. Toast the perilla seeds until aromatic, then grind them into a coarse powder.
4. In a mortar and pestle, crush green chilies, salt, and fermented soya bean (Hawaijar) into a coarse paste.
5. Combine the flaked fish, chopped vegetables, chili-Hawaijar paste, and perilla powder in a large mixing bowl.
6. Toss everything together thoroughly until well incorporated, garnish with fresh coriander, and serve immediately.
description: Nga Atoiba Singju is a signature Manipuri salad that highlights the region's unique reliance on fermented ingredients and fresh, earthy produce. It is a prized comfort food often served as a side dish or snack, reflecting the traditional Meitei culinary practice of blending smoked fish with aromatic local flora.
